discussion.key_messages: - Dry conditions with valley inversions persisting through Thursday before valley rain and mountain snow arrive this weekend that will help to mix out the inversions. - Another storm early next week could bring cooler temperatures aloft and more widespread precipitation, but confidence is low on the timing and track.
